result.title: Better Policies, Worse Verifier Audits
result.summary: Verifier stacks increasingly sit inside post-training and test-time compute loops. We study a specific control loop: a component verifier is evaluated on fresh policy outputs against the full success label and refreshed when that aggregate score falls. For a conjunctive target $y = F \wedge M$, its on-policy AUC is $(1-q)A_{\mathrm{own}} + qA_{\mathrm{cross}}$, where $q = \Pr[F=1 \mid y=0]$. As the policy masters $F$, $q$ can rise toward one, removing weight from $F$-failures and rewarding information about $M$. We call this on-policy audit collapse. We derive a sharp identified set, a complete-erasure threshold, and the exact point at which the audit can prefer a worse component verifier; its population optimum is the full-outcome predictor, not the component oracle. An exact oracle exhibits the collapse, a natural multi-label text control shows inversion can select a head with lower canonical $F$-AUC at the observed failure mixture, and a prediction-registered ECG study shows that acting on the audit can reduce off-policy $F$-AUC, transfer the damage to an unseen generator, and increase downstream constraint violations. Preserving own-failure support prevents the damage. Matching label-complexity bounds and a controlled-mixture audit give the corresponding repair: audit the component on its own failures, and keep those failures in the refresh distribution.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究策略改进后组件验证器的在策略审计失效：针对合取目标推导 on-policy AUC 分解与「audit collapse」，给出识别集、完全擦除阈值及修复方式，即在组件自身失败样本上审计并保留失败分布。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽非视觉或多模态工作，但其关于测试时/后训练验证器审计分布偏移、失败支持保留与验证器选择的分析，可能为 LVR 中验证器训练、停止决策和贡献分配提供可核查线索。
